verdict.rationale: LiveKit documents two narrow, product-native event-triggered behaviors. Telephony dispatch rules route inbound callers to rooms, and auto-egress starts recording automatically when a room is created. Neither amounts to a general user-definable rules engine, so this counts as partial support. Missing for 10: a general-purpose rules or trigger system across arbitrary events, configurable action types beyond call routing and recording, documented webhook/event subscriptions, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can define rules that trigger actions automatically on events

citations.quote: All callers can be placed in the same room or different rooms based on the dispatch rules.
It starts recording automatically when a room is created.
